column3: Display your heart rate in game!
Show HR Zone's own counter in game. Turn it off to see the heart rate only through Counters+ or to hide gameplay counters entirely. Applies from the next level.
column20: 在游戏中显示 HR Zone 自己的计数器。关闭后可通过 Counters+ 查看心率，或完全隐藏游戏内心率计数器。从下一关开始生效。

column3: Show the heart rate counter on a Counters+ canvas. Its position comes from Counters+ settings. Applies from the next level.
column20: 在 Counters+ 画布上显示心率计数器，位置由 Counters+ 的设置决定。从下一关开始生效。

column3: Disable the glow around the in-game counter number and heart icon? The counter previews in the settings never glow.
column20: 是否禁用游戏内计数器数字与心形图标的泛光效果？设置中的计数器预览不会发光。

column3: Keep the in-game counter hidden until the feed delivers a heart rate, then reveal it. Once revealed it never hides again for the rest of the level.
column20: 在数据源返回心率之前隐藏游戏内计数器，之后显示它。一旦显示，本关卡内不会再隐藏。

column3: Show the current time above the menu heart rate counter.
column20: 在菜单心率计数器上方显示当前时间。

column3: Show the heart rate counter in menus, independent of the autohide setting.
column20: 在菜单中显示心率计数器，不受自动隐藏设置的影响。

column3: Move the menu clock and heart rate counter block up or down.
column20: 上下移动菜单中的时钟与心率计数器区块。

column3: Move the menu clock and heart rate counter block closer to or farther from you.
column20: 将菜单中的时钟与心率计数器区块移近或移远。

column3: Tilt the menu clock and heart rate counter block forward or back from vertical.
column20: 前后倾斜菜单中的时钟与心率计数器区块（相对垂直位置）。

column3: Tint the heart icon with the heart rate's zone color, independent of the text toggle. Turn off to keep the icon image's own colors.
column20: 为心形图标按心率所在分区着色，独立于文字着色开关。关闭后保留图标自身的颜色。

column3: A simple starting point: 220 minus your age. Adjust it to how hard it actually feels.
column20: 简单的选择方法：220 减去你的年龄，再根据实际感受调整。

column3: Very light. Below 60 % of max HR
column20: 非常轻松。低于最大心率的 60 %

column3: Maximum. 90 % of max HR and above
column20: 极限强度。最大心率的 90 % 及以上

column3: This counter is powered by HR Zone. Its number color · heart icon · bloom are configured in HR Zone settings.
column20: 此计数器由 HR Zone 提供数据。数字颜色、心形图标与泛光效果在 HR Zone 的设置中调整。

column3: HR Zone integration is off — turn it on in HR Zone settings
column20: HR Zone 集成已关闭 —— 请在 HR Zone 设置中开启
